component: Bundled notification expiry cleanup and source phases

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned cleanup removes only PREBAKED-EoY25-2 from all three identical branding arrays. Spring26 remains alongside ESR 26 and both EoY26 objects; the fixed accepted arrays lack Spring26 because of a later phase. The unchanged unit test requires each non-test default notification's end_at to be after Date.now(), skipping only BAKED-20250725-TEST. Removing an expired object addresses that time-sensitive data contract without changing the assertion, loader, fallback trigger or scheduler. Data equality and exact blobs establish the removal scope; historical failure/verification reports and a real notification display remain separate. No notification or test suite was run.
title: The EoY25-2 expiry cleanup retains Spring26 in its owned post-state
